sections.label: Southeast Asian ISIS fighters
sections.summary: Hundreds of Southeast Asian terrorists fight for ISIS in Syria and Iraq, and some returned home wanting a regional wilayat.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: Hundreds of terrorists from Southeast Asia are fighting for ISIS in Syria and Iraq.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: Some of them have returned home with their networks, expertise and radical ideology.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: They want to establish a wilayat, a province under the ISIS caliphate, in the region.

sections.label: Singapore ageing population
sections.summary: By 2030, one in four Singaporeans will be 65 or older, with two working-age citizens per senior, down from five.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: By 2030, one in four Singaporeans will be aged 65 or older.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: There will be only two working-age citizens for every senior citizen, down from five today.

sections.label: Tangible improvements to lives
sections.summary: 81,000 families got new HDB homes, 760 more buses ran, and 40 rail stations were added.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: Our lives improved tangibly: 81,000 families received keys to new HDB homes; there were 760 more buses on the roads; and we added 40 new stations to our rail network.

sections.label: Long-term investments for Singapore
sections.summary: Long-term investments include doubling the rail network by 2030, building T4 and T5, hospitals, polyclinics, and new developments.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: But we also built for a better future.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: We committed to long-term investments that will transform Singapore: doubling our rail network by 2030, building T4 and T5 in Changi, building more hospitals and polyclinics, refreshing old towns like Toa Payoh and planning new developments, such as Bidadari, Tengah and the Southern Waterfront City, in the longer term.

sections.label: Increased ISIS terrorism threat
sections.summary: The threat from ISIS and terrorism has increased significantly.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: The threat from ISIS and terrorism has increased significantly.

sections.label: Committee on the Future Economy
sections.summary: The Committee on the Future Economy will develop strategies to keep Singapore relevant and competitive.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: The Committee on the Future Economy will develop strategies to ensure that Singapore remains relevant and competitive.

sections.label: SkillsFuture for workers' future jobs
sections.summary: SkillsFuture must succeed so workers can master skills and be equipped for future jobs.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: SkillsFuture must succeed because only by mastering skills can workers be equipped for the jobs of the future.

sections.label: Government keeping healthcare affordable
sections.summary: The Government will keep healthcare affordable, accessible and of high quality.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: The Government will keep healthcare affordable, accessible and of high quality.

sections.label: Action Plan for Successful Ageing
sections.summary: The Action Plan for Successful Ageing will help seniors lead fuller and more fulfilling lives.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: The Action Plan for Successful Ageing will help our seniors lead fuller and more fulfilling lives.

sections.label: Building best home for Singaporeans
sections.summary: The Government will continue building the best home for Singaporeans with more affordable, high-quality public housing and vibrant communities.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: Fourth, we will continue to build the best home for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: We are building more affordable, high-quality public housing, supporting vibrant communities surrounded by beautiful Page: 17 green and blue spaces.

sections.label: Urban landscape transformation projects
sections.summary: Some projects, like the Southern Waterfront City and Paya Lebar Airbase re-development, will transform the urban landscape.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: Some, like the Southern Waterfront City and the re-development of Paya Lebar Airbase, will transform our urban landscape.

sections.label: Capable and honest political leadership
sections.summary: Singapore must continue to have a capable and honest political leadership.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: First, we must continue to have a capable and honest political leadership.

sections.label: Political system and effective government
sections.summary: The passage states a political system must let a government govern effectively and in the interest of all, discouraging narrow interest-based politics.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: Page: 18 Second, we must have a political system that enables a government to govern effectively and in the interest of all.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: Our system discourages narrow interest-based politics and encourages clear electoral outcomes.

sections.label: Modifications to electoral system
sections.summary: The passage states Singapore modified its first-past-the-post system, instituting NCMPs, NMPs and GRCs to represent views and minority races.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: This is why over the years we have modified the first-past-the-post electoral system to suit Singapore's circumstances and needs.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: We instituted Non-Constituency Members of Parliament (NCMPs) to ensure that those who voted against the governing party will always have their views represented in Parliament.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: We created Nominated Members of Parliament (NMPs) to offer non-partisan views from various sectors of society.

sentences.speaker: The President (Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam)
sentences.text: We formed Group Representation Constituencies (GRCs) to guarantee at least a minimum representation of Malay, Indian and other minority race Members of Parliament.
